method: WebSearch 'arxiv 2026 <technique>' (R9, only-seen). Each: the NEW capability it enables that older methods lacked, + usability evidence (code/pretrained) for R13.
queries_used: arxiv 2026 time series foundation model zero-shot forecasting open source github sensor
arxiv 2026 neural operator Fourier physics simulation sparse sensors open source code
arxiv 2026 hyperspectral foundation model self-supervised few-shot pretrained code github
arxiv 2026 vision language model zero-shot few-shot anomaly detection industrial inspection code

techniques.name: Time-series foundation models (zero-shot forecasting)
techniques.new_capability: Zero-shot forecasting of an unseen time series with NO task-specific training data -- a pretrained model forecasts a new process's sensor stream out of the box. Older ML needed a labeled history per process.
techniques.usability_evidence: multiple open-source repos + compact pretrained checkpoints (WindFM 8.1M, Reverso 2.6M, Mamba4Cast)

techniques.name: Fourier Neural Operator for sparse-sensor field reconstruction
techniques.exemplars: RecFNO (arXiv:2302.09808, flow/heat field from sparse observations), neuraloperator library; Spectral-Inspired Neural Operator w/ limited data (2505.21573)
techniques.new_capability: Reconstruct a FULL continuous physical field (e.g. internal temperature/heat) from only 5-10 sparse point sensors, resolution-invariant, with zero-shot super-resolution. Older CNN/POD methods need dense imaging or fail at super-resolution.
techniques.usability_evidence: neuraloperator is a mature open library; RecFNO method published with results

techniques.name: Hyperspectral foundation models (self-supervised, few-shot)
techniques.exemplars: SpectralEarth (arXiv:2408.08447, pretrained at scale), HyperFM (2604.21127), SpecAware (2510.27219), Cross-Domain Transfer of HSI FMs (2604.26478)
techniques.new_capability: Label-EFFICIENT hyperspectral classification: an SSL-pretrained backbone fine-tunes on a FEW labeled samples. Older hyperspectral+ML (Run-22 mature approach) needs a large labeled dataset, which doesn't exist for niche processes.
techniques.usability_evidence: SpectralEarth releases dataset + pretrained foundation models

techniques.name: Vision-language model zero-shot / few-shot anomaly detection
techniques.new_capability: Detect/localize anomalies on UNSEEN objects with NO labeled defect data, via CLIP-based prompting / in-context learning. Older anomaly detection needed a labeled defect dataset per object.
techniques.usability_evidence: FADE code public on GitHub; CLIP backbones are standard
